text: {"lessons":["My account is still below its starting value despite a brief recovery, so I should judge progress over a meaningful horizon rather than treat one positive month as a turnaround.","Not trading has avoided reacting to volatility, but inaction is not a plan; I should periodically compare my allocation with my risk tolerance and rebalance if it has drifted materially.","As I approach retirement, I should keep enough liquidity for near-term needs and avoid taking more investment risk than I can comfortably sustain."]}
